summary: First empirical CPU-vs-GPU intermediate-stage diff on canonical 7B teacher. PR-B's APR_GPU_STAGE_DUMP scaffold captures GPU embedding, post_ffn_residual (layer 27), final_norm, and logits + CPU logits (parity_gate). Bug LOCALIZED to LM head dispatch: GPU intermediate values (post_ffn_residual, final_norm) look numerically sane; the systematic anti-correlation emerges in lm_head.

gpu_post_ffn_residual_layer_27.interpretation: Reasonable hidden-state magnitudes for residual-stream at end of 28-layer stack.

gpu_final_norm.interpretation: Post-RMSNorm magnitudes look correct (typical post-norm rms ≈ 2-3).

diff_result.interpretation: Systematic anti-correlation + 2.43 mean offset. Not random noise; not pure negation (cos=-0.005, not -1).

localization.stage: LM head dispatch (dispatch_lm_head_and_download → q6k_gemv_into for Qwen 7B Q4_K_M LM head)
evidence: GPU post_ffn_residual at layer 27 has reasonable rms=26 (typical for end-of-stack residual)
GPU final_norm has reasonable rms=2.84 (typical post-RMSNorm)
GPU logits have mean=0.0134 — well-centered — whereas CPU has mean=-2.42
The CPU's logits have a clear negative bias (most tokens unlikely, predicted token strongly positive) — Qwen's typical inference signature
The GPU's logits look mean-centered — suggesting the LM head matmul produces a different output than expected
localization.fault_class: Layout/stride bug in q6k_gemv_into or its dispatch (per memory project_ship_007_attention_parity_investigation.md: 'bug is layout/stride/buffer, NOT arithmetic')
localization.hypothesis: lm_head weight may be stored with wrong shape interpretation OR the gemv kernel uses wrong stride. The Q4_K_M GGUF stores lm_head as a [vocab_size, hidden_dim] matrix that must be matmul'd with hidden_state[hidden_dim] to produce logits[vocab_size]. If the kernel transposes or strides incorrectly, the output is systematically wrong.

next_slice_for_pr_e.verify_step_1: Run apr trace --save-tensor final_norm on the canonical APR teacher and confirm CPU final_norm == GPU final_norm (modulo Q4K tolerance) for single BOS token. If they match, the bug is confirmed in LM head dispatch.
next_slice_for_pr_e.verify_step_2: Compute logits manually from GPU's final_norm using a CPU q6k decoder + lm_head matmul; verify those logits match CPU's logits (would confirm GPU's final_norm is correct).
fix_candidates: Read q6k_gemv_into kernel: check vocab_size and hidden_dim are passed correctly to the kernel
Check stride/leading dimension: lm_head_weight is logically [vocab_size, hidden_dim] but Q4_K_M stores in super-block rows. Q6K super-blocks must be addressed by row not column.
Check the row indexing in the kernel: e.g., if the kernel reads weight[vocab][hidden] instead of weight[vocab × bytes_per_row + sb] → wrong indexing
Compare q6k_gemv_into Q6K specifically against the production CPU q6k_matvec used in OwnedQuantizedModel::forward_single_with_cache

ship_percent_impact: MODEL-1 unchanged at 99%. Localization complete; fix is single GPU kernel surface (q6k_gemv_into). PR-E ships fix + discharge proof.
